verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any feature for publishing selected notes as a public, browsable website or digital garden with working links. The closest item, "Grant others view-only access to notes," is access sharing rather than site publishing, and the Markdown exports and API are only building blocks for doing this outside the app.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can publish selected notes as a browsable website — a digital garden with working links — without leaving the app
